_comment: agentmux adapter for Claude Code. Merge the 'hooks' object into ~/.claude/settings.json. Requires `agentmux` on PATH and jq. $PPID inside a hook command is the Claude Code process (used for stale-state cleanup, Q-005; unverified, see Q-015). PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure set working so an approved permission prompt stops showing waiting once the tool finishes. Notification maps notification_type (one jq call): permission_prompt -> waiting/permission; elicitation_dialog, elicitation_url_dialog, agent_needs_input -> waiting/input; any other type (idle_prompt, auth_*, quota_*, ...) is ignored, so done stays done. Without notification_type (older Claude Code) the message is matched instead. Commands run under sh -c, so they must stay POSIX sh. Tested by test/core.sh.

hooks.command: o=$(jq -r '(.notification_type // "") as $t | (.message // "") as $m | (if $t == "" then (if ($m | test("ermission")) then "permission" else "input" end) elif $t == "permission_prompt" then "permission" elif $t == "elicitation_dialog" or $t == "elicitation_url_dialog" or $t == "agent_needs_input" then "input" else "" end), $m'); r=$(printf '%s\n' "$o" | head -n 1); [ -z "$r" ] || printf '%s\n' "$o" | sed 1d | agentmux set waiting --reason "$r" --msg - --harness claude --pid $PPID
